title: vitex ferruginea subsp. amboniensis
intro: Vitex ferruginea subsp. amboniensis, commonly known as the Indonesian privet or Ambon vitex, is a plant species within the Verbenaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Vitex ferruginea subsp. amboniensis include its anti-anxiety, anti-inflammatory, and sedative effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids and terpenoids. Bioactive constituents present in Vitex ferruginea subsp. amboniensis include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
